name: WattWise
tagline: AI energy & carbon copilot for smart campuses
problem: Labs, ACs and lights run all night and on weekends
The only feedback is a monthly bill, weeks late
No one knows if rooftop solar would really pay off
Green drives fade because savings are never measured

stats.label: CO2 per kWh on India's grid (approx., CEA)
of India's electricity is used by buildings (approx., BEE)
yearly use of our 6-building demo campus (synthetic)

solution: Reads hourly meter data for every campus building
Forecasts next week and flags waste with a plain reason
Converts every kWh to rupees, CO2 and trees
Plans rooftop solar and simulates savings before you spend

features.title: 7-day forecast
features.desc: Hourly per building, split into calendar baseline + weather effect

features.title: Waste detective
features.desc: Robust z-score alerts: '18 kW at 3 AM Sun vs 3 kW typical'

features.title: Carbon ledger
features.desc: kWh to rupees to kg CO2 to trees, with named, editable factors

features.title: Solar planner
features.desc: kWp, payback, 25-year cash flow and CO2 avoided for any roof

features.title: What-if levers
features.desc: AC setpoint, auto-off, LED and BLDC - live savings, no double count

features.title: Green leaderboard
features.desc: Weather-normalised savings vs own baseline; Green Champion badge

architecture: Meters / CSV -> hourly kWh + temperature per building
dataset.py -> deterministic synthetic campus with ground truth
forecast.py -> robust weighted regression, Holt-Winters baseline
anomaly.py -> median + MAD per hour-of-week, rule-based causes
solar.py / whatif.py / leaderboard.py -> decisions in rupees and CO2
app.py -> stdlib HTTP JSON API; static/ -> vanilla JS + SVG dashboard
algorithms: Weighted ridge regression (Gaussian elimination) - hourly load forecast
Robust trimming from category medians - waste never becomes 'normal'
Modified z-score (median + MAD) - waste event detection
Degraded cash-flow model - solar payback and 25-year savings
innovation: Every forecast and alert explains itself - no black box
Buildings compete with their own weather-adjusted past
Detection to rupees to fix to solar, all in one offline tool
Zero dependencies: runs on a Rs 15k laptop with no internet

results.label: waste-event precision / recall vs injected truth
monthly saving from 4 cheap levers (Rs 10.7 L/yr, demo)
